03b_1_christoffel_heat_maps.png: The 512 Christoffel symbols $\Gamma^{a}{}_{bc}$ of the corrected metric at the point $z = \pi/4$ on the slice $a_4 = 0.5$ of the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($a_4^{\prime} = 1$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$ and $b_4^{\prime}/b_4 = 4/3$, $H = 1$), as eight heat maps, one for each upper index $a = x_0, \dots, x_7$; in each map the row is $b$ and the column is $c$ (numbers $0$ to $7$ for $x_0$ to $x_7$), the colour is the value on a symmetric logarithmic scale (grey zero, red positive, blue negative) and every non-zero value is printed. Only 31 of the 512 squares are coloured, each map is symmetric about its diagonal, and every non-zero symbol has at least one index equal to $x_4$ or $x_0$, the two coordinates on which the metric depends; the 3-space maps have no entry with $x_0$, because 3-space has no warp.
03b_2_christoffel_versus_z.png: The absolute values of five Christoffel symbols of the corrected metric across one cell $0 < z < \pi$ (two halves joined at the fold $z = \pi/2$, dotted), for $a_4 = 0.5$, $a_4^{\prime} = 1$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$, $b_4^{\prime}/b_4 = 4/3$ (the history at $a_4 = 0.5$), $H = 1$, on a logarithmic vertical axis; horizontal axis $z = 6Hx_0$ in radians, vertical axis the absolute value in units of $H$. $\Gamma^{x_5}{}_{x_5x_0} = H\cot z$ is large at the tips and vanishes at the fold, $\Gamma^{x_0}{}_{x_0x_0}$ is large at the tips and at the fold, $\Gamma^{x_0}{}_{x_5x_5}$ grows towards the fold, $\Gamma^{x_4}{}_{x_0x_0}$ grows towards the tips, and $\Gamma^{x_1}{}_{x_1x_4} = a_4^{\prime} = 1$ is the same everywhere; every curve is symmetric about the fold.
03b_3_finite_differences.png: The largest difference between the 512 Christoffel symbols computed numerically by central differences of the metric and the exact symbols, at the test point $H = 0.23$, $a_4 = 0.17$, $a_4^{\prime} = 0.61$, $a_4^{\prime\prime} = -0.37$, $b_4 = 1.37$, $b_4^{\prime} = 0.31$, $b_4^{\prime\prime} = -0.23$, $x_0 = 0.41$ of the Revision record, against the step $h$, on logarithmic axes; horizontal axis $h$, vertical axis the error in units of $H$. For large steps the error follows the dashed line of slope 2 (error proportional to $h^2$); the smallest error, $1.5 \times 10^{-10}$, is reached at $h = 10^{-6}$; for smaller steps the rounding errors of the computer, which grow like $1/h$, take over.
03b_4_plane_curvatures.png: The curvature $\sigma(a, b) = R^{ab}{}_{ab}$ (no sum) of the plane of $x_a$ (row) and $x_b$ (column), unit $H^2$, on the first slice $a_4 = 0$, $b_4 = 1$ ($k = 1$) of the history $a_4 = AHx_4$, $b_4 = e^{4AHx_4/3}$ ($a_4^{\prime\prime} = 0$, $H = 1$) for $A = 0.5$, $1$ (canonical) and $2$ (left to right); red positive, blue negative (sphere-like and saddle-like only for two space-like directions; with $x_4$ a positive value means $d^2\xi/d\tau^2 = +\sigma\xi$). Inside 3-space and 3-space with $x_4$ $a_4^{\prime 2}$ ($0.25$, $1$, $4$); 3-space with $x_0$ or an extra time $-a_4^{\prime 2}/3$ ($-0.0833$, $-0.333$, $-1.33$); $x_4$ with $x_0$ or an extra time $a_4^{\prime 2}/9$ ($0.0278$, $0.111$, $0.444$); inside the block of $x_0$ and the extra times $a_4^{\prime 2}/9 - H^2 k$ ($-0.972$, $-0.889$, $-0.556$). The rows and columns of $x_0$ repeat those of the extra times.
03b_5_riemann_and_kretschmann_z.png: Left: across one cell $0 < z < \pi$, the absolute values of the Christoffel symbols $\Gamma^{x_0}{}_{x_0x_0}$ (dashed) and $\Gamma^{x_5}{}_{x_5x_0} = H\cot z$ (solid), which depend on the coordinate $x_0$ and grow without bound at the tips, and of the plane curvatures $\sigma(x_5, x_6)$ (dash-dotted) and $\sigma(x_1, x_0)$ (dotted), which are the same at every $z$, for $a_4^{\prime} = 1.5$ on the history at the slice $a_4 = 0.5$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$, $H = 1$; horizontal axis $z = 6Hx_0$ in radians, vertical axis logarithmic, units $H$ and $H^2$. Right: the Kretschmann scalar $K$ summed numerically from all 112 components at 300 values of $z$ for $a_4^{\prime} = 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2$ (in units of $H$) at the same slice, vertical axis $K$ in units of $H^4$, logarithmic. $K$ is the same at every $z$: $46.75$, $69.13$, $181$, $494.2$.
03b_6_scalars_versus_a.png: The curvature scalars of the corrected metric along the deflating history $a_4 = AHx_4$, $b_4 = e^{4AHx_4/3}$ ($a_4^{\prime} = AH$, $a_4^{\prime\prime} = 0$, $b_4^{\prime}/b_4 = \tfrac43 AH$) as functions of the slope $A$ from $0.1$ to $3$, with $H = 1$, at the three slices $a_4 = 0$ (solid), $1$ (dashed) and $2$ (dotted), where $k = e^{2a_4/3} = 1$, $1.95$ and $3.79$; horizontal axes $A$ (a pure number), the dotted vertical line marks the canonical $A = 1$ of the Revision record. Left: the Ricci scalar $R = (56A^2/9 - 12k)H^2$ in units of $H^2$ ($R = -5.778$, $-17.15$, $-39.3$ at $A = 1$). Right, on a logarithmic axis in units of $H^4$: the Kretschmann scalar $K$ (red) and $\sum R^a{}_b R^b{}_a$ (blue), both positive for every $A$; as $k$ grows along the history, the curvature of the shrinking block of the hidden direction and the extra times grows ($K = 48.49$ at $A = 1$, $a_4 = 0$).
03b_7_einstein_tensor.png: The Einstein tensor $G^{\mu}{}_{\nu}$ of the corrected metric along the deflating history $a_4 = AHx_4$, $b_4 = e^{4AHx_4/3}$ with $H = 1$, in units of $H^2$; it has no off-diagonal component. Left: the eight diagonal components for the canonical slope $A = 1$ of the Revision record at the first slice $a_4 = 0$ (hatched bars: $-2/3$, $41/9$ three times, $19/3$, $-2/3$ three times) and at the last slice $a_4 = 2$ (plain bars: $3e^{4/3} - 11/3 = 7.72$, $6e^{4/3} - 13/9 = 21.3$ three times, $6e^{4/3} + 1/3 = 23.1$, $7.72$ three times); the hidden component equals the extra-time ones. Right: the 3-space (solid), hidden and extra-time (dotted) and time (dashed) components versus the time $x_4$ along the canonical history, where $k = e^{2x_4/3}$; the shaded gap $(3k + 4)H^2$ between the time and the hidden component never closes.
